title: A contact book
description:
Keep contacts in a `Map` and look them up.

```
add("Ada", "555-0142")     -> true
add("ada", "555-9999")     -> false (already there)
find("ADA")                -> { name: "Ada", phone: "555-0142" }
search("55")               -> ["Ada", "Bob"]
remove("Cy")               -> false
```
hints: `contacts.has(key)`, `contacts.set(key, { name, phone })`, `contacts.get(key)` and `contacts.delete(key)` (which returns true or false) are all you need.
requirements: Keys are lower-case names, so lookups ignore case; keep the name as first typed in the value.
`add` refuses a name that already exists; `remove` reports whether it removed anything.
`search(text)` returns the names (sorted) whose name or phone contains the text.
stretch: Save and load the book with `JSON.stringify` and `JSON.parse` (a `Map` must become an array first).
